title: Mom's Basic Vegetable Beef Stew
description: Mom's basic vegetable beef stew recipe is loaded with potatoes, onions, carrots, and celery for an easy, hearty, and warming meal for cold evenings.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil, or as needed
salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 (32 ounce) can diced tomatoes with juice
4 potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks

steps.text: Add enough oil to a large stockpot to thinly coat the bottom; heat over medium. Add 1 onion, carrots, garlic, bay leaf, red pepper flakes, Greek seasoning, rosemary, thyme, basil, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper; cook and stir until mixture begins to soften and brown, about 15 minutes.
Add tomatoes and ground beef, breaking beef apart with a wooden spoon; bring to a boil. Cook until beef is cooked through and carrots are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add potatoes, remaining 1 onion, and celery; cook until potatoes are tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat; let sit before serving for 20 to 30 minutes.
